reading.text:
Reading of spec eq_compid, clause "the compensation formula" ((2.1)).
Setting: standing basis; N a Poisson random measure on R_+ x E with intensity dt x nu (nu sigma-finite,
infinite activity allowed), compatible with (F_t) (the filtration is generated by W, N, F_0, augmented;
N((s,t] x A) independent of F_s for nu(A)<infty).
Claim: for every predictable psi >= 0 (psi: Omega x [0,T] x E -> [0,infty], calP ⊗ calE-measurable),
E int_0^T int_E psi_s(e) N(ds,de) = E int_0^T int_E psi_s(e) nu(de) ds, both sides in [0,infty] (extended
nonnegative reals; equality allowed to be infinity = infinity).
Faithful formal: quantified over all nonnegative predictable psi (extended-real or real nonnegative valued),
integrals as lintegrals (no integrability hypothesis), N the paper's PRM pathwise integral (int ... N(omega)
(ds,de)), on [0,T]. Narrower if restricted to integrable psi, bounded psi, simple psi, or deterministic psi;
mismatched if psi only measurable (false then) unless the Lean adds predictability. The predictable sigma-
field must be that of the standing filtration.

comparison.text:
Comparison, eq_compid (Sec2Basics.lean:54-65) vs reading.
- Setting: Lévy driver D with σ-finite ν; 𝒢₀ ≤ mΩ independent of the driver's filtration (the paper's
  independent F_0); the filtration enlJoint 𝒢₀ D (the standing one). Matches.
- ∀ T ∈ ℝ, ∀ ψ : Ω × ℝ × E → [0,∞] measurable for the marked predictable σ-algebra of enlJoint
  (generated by F × (r,q] × B, F ∈ F_r, r ≥ 0, ν(B) < ∞; by σ-finiteness of ν this is P ⊗ 𝓔 on the
  positive times, which is all the integrals see). Matches "predictable ψ ≥ 0", values in [0,∞].
- Conclusion: ∫⁻ ω ∫⁻_{(0,T] × E} ψ(ω,·) dN(ω) dP = ∫⁻ ω ∫⁻_{(0,T]} ∫⁻_E ψ dν ds dP, in [0,∞]. Matches
  (2.1) (∫_0^T read on (0,T]; N has no mass at time 0 a.s. and Lebesgue none at {0}).
- No integrability hypothesis: matches. Predictability w.r.t. the enlarged augmented filtration with the
  independence hypothesis present: the setting in which (2.1) holds.
- Witness sec2_compensation_nonzero_hypotheses: a nonzero instance (both sides = 1).
Verdict: faithful with representation choices.

verdict.detail:
Representation choices: (1) ψ is a function on Ω × ℝ × E measurable for LevyStochCalc's marked
predictable σ-algebra (generated by predictable rectangles F × (r,q] × B with ν(B) < ∞, r ≥ 0) --
the paper's P ⊗ 𝓔 on positive times, by σ-finiteness of ν; (2) ∫_0^T read over (0, T]; (3) N is the
driver's random measure on ℝ × E, integrated pathwise as a lintegral; (4) T ranges over ℝ (both sides
vanish for T ≤ 0). Harmless.
